summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a routine daily share repurchase under a buy-back program announced 5 August 2026. On 17 August 2026, HSBC purchased 850,000 shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of 15.3596 GBP and 335,200 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$163.3113 per share, for aggregate consideration since commencement of US$201.1 million. Shares were bought from BNP Paribas and cancelled, reducing issued capital to 17,177,053,842 shares. This is a capital return via ongoing market buy-back, not an issuer tender offer. What to watch: continued daily repurchase volumes and capital return pace.
